keyword: has anyone won back to back masters
claims: Four golfers have won the Masters back-to-back in tournament history.
Jack Nicklaus won the Masters in 1965 and 1966.
Nick Faldo won the Masters in 1989 and 1990.
Tiger Woods won the Masters in 2001 and 2002.
Rory McIlroy won the Masters in 2025 and 2026.
Only Jack Nicklaus, Nick Faldo, Tiger Woods, and Rory McIlroy have won the Masters back-to-back.
Only these four players have achieved consecutive victories in the Masters tournament's history
